senses.gloss: मुनि- + पुत्रक मुनि- + पुत्रक, m. a wagtail.

मुनि मुनि, i. e. मन् + इ (उ for अ, by the influence of the preceding labial),
 I. m.
 1. A holy sage, endowed with divine inspiration, Vikr. d. 3.
 2. An ascetic, Pañc. 34, 13.
 3. The saint Agastya, Vyāsa, Kir. 5, 49.
 4. The name of two plants.
 II. f. नी̆, A female saint.
 --Comp.
मुनि- + वर मुनि- + वर, m. the chief of the ascetics, Ṛt. 6, 30.
मुनि- + श्रेष्ठ मुनि- + श्रेष्ठ, m. an excellent sage, Lass. 48, 3.
